root_cause.text: NULL pointer dereference in intel_dmc_update_dc6_allowed_count() caused by using the hardware DC6 state register (DC_STATE_EN) to decide whether to call the function, which can be invoked before the DMC structure is initialized (i.e., before intel_dmc_init()) when probe calls gen9_set_dc_state() if DC6 is enabled in hardware.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states "intel_dmc_update_dc6_allowed_count() oopses when DMC hasn't been initialized, and dmc is thus NULL" and describes the call path where intel_power_domains_init_hw() leads to gen9_set_dc_state() before intel_dmc_init(). The patch changes `dc6_was_enabled = val & DC_STATE_EN_UPTO_DC6` to `dc6_was_enabled = power_domains->dc_state & DC_STATE_EN_UPTO_DC6` in gen9_set_dc_state(), and similarly in intel_dmc_get_dc6_allowed_count() to use software state instead of reading the hardware register.
